_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from TibiaWiki 'Thaian-Venorean Road' text + map (Thaian-Venorean_Road.png). Tibia 7.4 vanilla (implemented 7.1); verify on Rivalia. Overland surface road connecting Thais and Venore across the mainland.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground surface). Entire road is surface (z=7).
_meta.legend: steps[] follow the white road line on the map W→E from Thais to Venore. heading = cardinal direction of travel; landmarks are the buildings/POI passed along the road.

start.note: Thais NE gate. The road is the classic mainland link between the two cities; also the safer of the two 'leave the road OK' legs per Mainland Trails.

min_level_note: Low-mid level friendly if on the road; the surrounding wilds hold tougher spawns. Venore Dragon Lair sits off the east end.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Leave Thais by the NE gate. The white road heads N/NE out of the city, past the Thais Graveyard and Dark Mansion.

steps.heading: NE
steps.text: Follow the road NE, climbing toward the high ground. It crosses a river bridge and rises over Mount Sternum — the road's high point (Mount Sternum Outlook Tower / Triangle Tower area).

steps.heading: peak
steps.text: Over the top of Mount Sternum the road turns and begins descending eastward. Lubo's Adventurer-Shop and Postal Service HQ sit along this stretch.

steps.heading: SE
steps.text: Descend SE toward the sand belt — the road skirts the NORTH edge of the Jakundaf Desert (the tan region on the map). Stay on the road; the desert interior is exposed.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: Continue E across the plains past Mac Noodles and the Wolftower. Alatar Lake and Riverspring are off to the sides.

steps.heading: E
steps.text: The road runs into the Venore wetlands and arrives at the Venore Horse Station on the SW side of the city. Venore Dragon Lair is nearby to the E — Dragon hazard off-road.

return_shortcut.text: Same road in reverse (Venore → Thais): W over Mount Sternum then S down into Thais. Alternatively take the Venore boat/carpet travel to skip the walk entirely.
